description: 県所管_水位データ [flood] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 長野県. 長野県河川砂防情報ステーションに掲載している県所管の水位データを掲載しております。 毎年４月下旬頃をめどに前年度のデータを掲載します。 観測局の異常値が記載されている可能性もありますのでご了承ください。. Coverage: 長野県. The portal files it under the publisher 長野県. Its tags are 水位. It offers 17 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2023-08-21 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
